title: Knowledge applicability

questions.text: Does the retrieved company knowledge actually apply to this account state?

inputs: offered knowledge: situation signature, guidance, exceptions
account state fields, buying group, open signals
knowledge the candidate cited and followed

criteria.text: every signature condition holds in the current state
criteria.guide: Check each situation_signature condition against state fields and open signals ('diff.<signal>' = an open signal).

criteria.text: no exception of the knowledge holds
criteria.guide: Only when the signature holds: if any exception's conditions hold, the knowledge must not be applied.

criteria.text: the candidate follows applicable knowledge and ignores inapplicable knowledge
criteria.guide: Applicable guidance is followed; inapplicable or excepted guidance is neither cited nor followed.

principles: This protects against semantic retrieval finding a superficially similar play that should not be used.

labels.label: APPLIES
labels.when: Signature holds and no exception holds.

labels.label: DOES_NOT_APPLY
labels.when: At least one signature condition fails.

labels.label: EXCEPTION_TRIGGERED
labels.when: Signature holds and an exception holds.
